header: Event facts as a short list
subheader: Date, time, place, price, language and capacity, beside an image.
lead: The rows are a definition list, not a styled grid. Screen readers can tell which part of each pair is the label and which is the value.
note: Dates are plain text, not date fields. Always include the year, so an old band is clearly out of date.

facts.title: Value
facts.text: Long enough for a date, short enough to stay on one line.

facts.title: Second line
facts.text: Each row can have a short extra sentence like this one.
